about.description: Alter SPVs is the label for a set of special purpose vehicles issuing XRP Ledger tokens said to represent economic interests in five private companies spanning aerospace, advanced materials, semiconductors, solar energy, and agricultural technology. The tokens do not confer direct share ownership and pricing comes from XRPL AMM pools rather than an external oracle or published NAV.
about.registryInfo: Alter SPVs holds an investment position in AeroNeura Ltd through a dedicated SPV. The tokenized instrument represents an economic interest in that SPV rather than direct ownership of AeroNeura Ltd shares. AeroNeura Ltd is an operating technology company developing advanced control systems, intelligent automation, propulsion testing software, and engineering solutions for the aerospace, automotive, defense, and industrial sectors.
